committedCopy: 6 of 70 shots removed before committing this report, and this file is therefore HAND-EDITED -- which it did not say until the fifth pass, in the file whose whole purpose is to account for where its shots came from. Reconcile it like this: merged[0] records the `early` run as shots: 22, replaced: 16, added: 6, and provenance says 48 + 16 = 64. The 16 REPLACED are the tracked poses' early column and they are here. The 6 ADDED are the local-overlay routes inventory-wc-elevated and owner-elevated, matched to the owner's own photographs -- they name a viewpoint, so they were removed by hand from `shots` and their frames were never copied out of scratch. That is why 48 + 16 + 6 = 70 and this file holds 64. The full 70-shot report and its frames stay in the session scratch folder. Nothing else was changed; absolute paths are rewritten. (early-regime-shoot.report.json is the same removal, disclosed there from the start; this file is the one that was not.)
